headline: Voter registration and voter checklist corrections, with the proof applicants must bring.
summary: Applicants can register to vote and have the checklist corrected. Those with proof of residency, citizenship, and age, plus a photo ID, should bring it. Those without proof may sign an affidavit instead.
items: Proof of citizenship (passport, birth certificate, naturalization papers)
